description: K₂NaCl₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaCl₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are a spread of K-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.23 Å. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent KCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.90 Å) and four longer (3.12 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to five equivalent K and one Na atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₅Na octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°.
